rawConfiguration.text:
## DetectAI overview (${environment})
**Sources:** OTEL spans/metrics/logs via otel-collector to EU (`otlp.eu01.nr-data.net`). Floci infra = exporter sidecars, prod infra = CloudWatch (see datastores dashboard). **Filters:** `deployment.environment = ${environment}`. Services: `web`, `payment-gateway`, `worker-analytics`, `worker-payments`, `worker-cron`, `inference`, `document-parser`, `chat-service`, `chat-worker`.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `spans/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}'

FROM Metric SELECT (sum(otelcol_exporter_sent_spans) / (sum(otelcol_exporter_sent_spans) + sum(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans) + 1)) * 100 AS `export ok %` WHERE service.name = 'otel-collector' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `spans/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET service.name TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET service.name TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind IN ('SERVER', 'CONSUMER') FACET service.name TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS errors WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (level = 'error' OR severity = 'ERROR') FACET service.name TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS throughput, percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %`, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms`, percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET service.name, service.version LIMIT 50
FROM Span SELECT max(duration.ms) AS `max ms`, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms`, count(*) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' FACET service.name, name LIMIT 25
FROM Span SELECT count(*) AS errors, latest(trace.id) AS `sample trace`, latest(name) AS span WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND error = true FACET service.name LIMIT 25

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `spans/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name IN ('payment-gateway', 'worker-analytics', 'worker-payments', 'worker-cron') FACET service.name TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT count(*) AS spans FACET service.name, service.version WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' LIMIT 50
